attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Georgia military retirement exemption (2025). Age-based tiers: Under 62 = $17.5k base + $17.5k if earned income >= $17.5k, 62-64 = $35k, 65+ = $65k. Moving to $65k for all ages in 2026. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, GA DOR.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize GA military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "GA Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ga_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply GA $35,000 military retirement exemption (age < 62, earned income >= $17.5k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.ga_military_exemption_under_62_base result.ga_military_exemption_under_62_earned_threshold add /ga_total_exemption_available xdef
result.military_retirement_pay ga_total_exemption_available min /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ga_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"GA military retirement exemption (age < 62, earned >= $17.5k): $" result.ga_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Earned: $" strconcat result.earned_income cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ga_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply GA $17,500 military retirement exemption (age < 62, earned < $17.5k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_exemption_under_62_base min /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ga_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"GA military retirement exemption (age < 62, earned < $17.5k): $" result.ga_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Earned: $" strconcat result.earned_income cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ga_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_exemption_62_to_64 min /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ga_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"GA military retirement exemption (age 62-64): $" result.ga_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ga_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_exemption_65_plus min /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ga_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ga_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"GA military retirement exemption (age 65+): $" result.ga_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ga_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ga_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No GA military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
